    ConnectingScreen
    Initial screen shown while the TUI waits for the server to confirm the connection and request login.

    Displays the single-match standings on the left and the cumulative DB leaderboard on the right; when the DB is unavailable the right column is replaced by a red alert.

    Terminal state of the TUI state machine.

    Main game screen, implemented as a non-blocking state machine that drives the stateless board/panel renderers in org.adsl.client.view.tui.game.

    Non-blocking home menu rendered with TextGraphics.
